searchLog.query: Audit all 18 Spanish, 10 Italian and 7 Portuguese contrasts in other-languages.json against ordinary-vocabulary and compatible-context depth requirements.
searchLog.outcome: Full replacements preserve contrast IDs and inherited evidence. New dictionary source IDs use lexical-eip-. Distinct spellings, not homograph senses, are counted for depth. No new audio or live curriculum changes.

searchLog.query: Primary Collins Spanish dictionaries and conjugation tables for new common words and first/final stress inflections.
searchLog.outcome: Opened entries for added vocabulary; editorial broad Mexican Spanish IPA, including seseo and initial trill, remains separate from dictionary form/sense evidence. Added one word per vowel to the existing final-a subgroup.

searchLog.query: Treccani primary entries for Italian singleton/geminate consonants and stressed mid-vowel quality.
searchLog.outcome: Read accent-marked headwords; replaced uncommon paca and specialized varo. Rejected tentative open-o assignments contradicted by Treccani before writing the candidate data. Same stressed/positional contexts retained.

searchLog.query: Priberam primary entries for Brazilian Portuguese lexical expansion and mid-vowel quality.
searchLog.outcome: Read forms/senses and marked vowel quality; retained existing documented stimulus links without assigning any new ones. Broad Brazilian IPA is an editorial adaptation, not Priberam-supplied Brazilian audio.

searchLog.query: Italian L2 geminate perception consonant length Japanese learners study affricates; Brazilian Portuguese L2 perception vowel nasal consonant contrasts Spanish speakers study; Spanish L2 perception consonant contrasts English learners tap trill voicing stress study
searchLog.outcome: Primary publisher records retrieved for Tsukada et al. consonant length and Martinez et al. Brazilian oral/nasal perception; these reinforce existing priorities. No additional contrast was rushed into the pack without lexical and context review.

searchLog.query: Check proposed lexemes against the project-held-out transfer pool.
searchLog.outcome: Private-list exclusion checked locally; 0 proposed memberships withheld. No held-out words are disclosed in this public artifact.
